Welcome to my website. I am **Feng Xiao (肖枫)**, a final-year Ph.D. Candidate (expected graduation 2027) in Applied Psychology at the **School of Humanities and Social Science, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen (CUHK-Shenzhen)**.

I am currently working with Professor **X.T. Wang**, who is my PhD advisor. My research broadly focuses on **behavioral decision-making, artificial intelligence and psychology, evolutionary psychology, and cognitive neuroscience**.

<div style="clear: both;"></div>
